summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting (i) issuance and sale of 31,142 common shares at ~$25.85 per share (approx. $805,000 aggregate) in a continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D to accredited investors, and (ii) disclosure of NAV of $25.85 per share and aggregate NAV of ~$124.3M as of June 30, 2026. This is a routine capital raise and periodic NAV update, not a special situation. No tender offer, restructuring, or strategic event is described.
